name: close
title: The close this month
subtitle: How far through each open period is, what is late, and who has what

sections.title: Close status
sections.sql: select period, business_days_in, target_close, tasks_finished||'/'||tasks as tasks, recs_reviewed||'/'||recs_needed as reconciliations, journals_unposted, flux_unexplained from close_status where state='open' order by period

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Late tasks and reconciliations, differences, variances, journals, reversals, auditor requests and rule checks.
sections.sql: select kind, period, item, detail from (select 1 as o,'task' as kind,period,task as item,owner||', '||days_late||' business days late' as detail from tasks_due where days_late>0 union all select 2,'reconcile',period,code||' '||account,owner||', '||state from recs_due where days_late>0 or balance_moved union all select 3,'difference',period,code||' '||account,issue from differences union all select 4,'journal',period,reference,state from journal_status where period_state='open' and state not in ('posted','cancelled') union all select 5,'rule',period,record,issue from compliance_gaps) x order by o, period, item

sections.title: Who has what
sections.sql: select owner as person, count(*) filter (where state='todo') as tasks, count(*) filter (where state='done') as awaiting_sign_off from tasks_due group by owner order by owner

sections.title: Reconciliations not reviewed
sections.sql: select period, code, account, risk, owner, reviewer, balance, state, unexplained, due from recs_due order by due, code

name: flux
title: Variance analysis
subtitle: Balances against last month, with the explanation or the gap

sections.title: Movements over the threshold
sections.sql: select f.period, f.code, f.account, f.prior_balance, f.balance, f.change, f.change_pct, coalesce(f.explanation,'Needs explaining') as explanation from flux f join period_list p on p.label=f.period where p.state='open' and (f.needs_explaining or f.explanation is not null) order by f.period, abs(f.change) desc

sections.title: Close speed
sections.note: Business days from month end to close.
sections.sql: select entity, month, target_close, days_to_close, state from period_list order by entity, period_end
